$comment: City Utility Twin AOI. Munich-sized core (about 3.1 x 3.8 km, like config/aoi/munich.json) centred on the Kessel: Hauptbahnhof and the Stuttgart 21 site, Schlossplatz, Charlottenplatz, south to Marienplatz. Decided 2026-10-05. Focus places and control points from OSM (ids below), queried 2026-10-05.

region.en: The Kessel from the main station to Marienplatz

$elevationComment: A basin: the Kessel floor sits around 240 m and the slopes inside the box climb towards the surrounding ridges (Bopser 483 m just south of it). Generous on purpose; it exists to catch a wrong region, not to describe this one.
